summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return dated October 16, 2026, covering open-market ADS repurchases made in August 2026. Reported buybacks span August 12–25, 2026, at prices from USD 21.22 to USD 23.00 per ADS, each ADS representing one Class A ordinary share; the largest single-day tranche was 235,447 ADS on August 24 at USD 21.22. Shares were repurchased but not yet cancelled, so issued share count stayed at 557,330,906; no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch cancellation timing and pace of further buybacks.
